name: DarkIcon
tagline: 为 iOS 15–18 提供深色图标与图片壁纸暗化。
description: DarkIcon 可在 iOS 15–17 为主屏幕、文件夹与 Spotlight 自动生成随系统外观切换的深色 App 图标，并在 iOS 16–18 为主屏幕与锁屏壁纸提供暗化效果。
壁纸暗化可根据图片亮度自适应调整，亮图增强暗化、暗图减少处理；也可手动调节强度并跟随系统深色模式。
iOS 18 保留系统原生深色图标，插件图标功能不会启用；iOS 17 及以下继续提供原有图标模式。
设置中的图标预览列表支持搜索、Light/Dark 对比，并标明使用 App 原生深色素材还是算法处理。
浅色模式跳过不必要的深色图标处理；深色结果通过磁盘缓存与限额内存缓存按需复用。
notice: ⚠️ 0.9.4 存在浅色模式下不必要处理图标的问题，建议尽快升级至 0.9.5。壁纸暗化不保证对所有系统、动态或特殊壁纸类型生效。iOS 15 使用系统自带壁纸暗化，不启用插件壁纸功能。
features: iOS 16–18 主屏幕与锁屏壁纸自适应暗化
根据图片亮度自动调整暗化程度，并支持手动强度调节
壁纸与图标开关独立控制，壁纸暗化默认关闭
iOS 15–17 跟随系统深浅色外观自动切换桌面图标
支持 Spotlight 下拉搜索中的深色图标显示
可搜索的图标预览列表，支持 Light/Dark 对比并标明原生或算法处理
预览与图标生成在后台按需执行，避免一次处理全部 App
浅色模式跳过不必要的深色图标处理，改善桌面启动
深色图标使用磁盘缓存与限额内存缓存，降低长期内存占用
设置内可清除图标缓存；预览直接复用磁盘结果
默认混合模式，并可单独选择 Apple 或 Chroma 模式
优先使用 App 自带深色图标，并增强 iOS 17 原生 Dark 素材读取；可选白色与浅灰色反转
改善浅底、渐变、圆角和备用图标的深色效果
改善日历日期与星期的可读性，同时保留主体颜色和细节
compatibility: 图标功能支持 iOS 15–17；插件壁纸暗化支持 iOS 16–18
iOS 15 使用系统壁纸暗化；iOS 18 使用系统原生深色图标
usage: 安装插件后重新加载桌面
进入“设置 → 深色图标”分别配置图标与壁纸暗化；壁纸暗化默认关闭，可选择自适应或手动强度
在图标预览列表中搜索 App，对比 Light/Dark 效果并查看原生或算法处理来源
需要时可在设置中使用“清除图标缓存”；主屏幕、文件夹、Spotlight 与预览会按需重建并复用结果
更新插件后重新加载 SpringBoard

changes: 紧急修复 0.9.4 在浅色模式下仍进行不必要图标处理的问题，改善桌面启动。
优化内存与缓存：移除长期原图缓存，深色图标改用磁盘缓存和限额内存缓存。
图标读取与生成改为后台按需执行，保留原生 Dark 优先；设置新增“清除图标缓存”，预览复用磁盘结果。
新增可搜索的图标预览列表，可对比 Light/Dark 效果并标明原生素材或算法处理。
预览按需加载并复用缓存；修复浅色模式残留深色图标，完善主屏幕、文件夹与 Spotlight 刷新。
增强 iOS 17 原生 Dark 素材优先策略，并修复错误图集和预览缩放导致的显示异常。
优化深色图标缓存，浅色模式下继续保留成品，减少主屏幕翻页、文件夹和图标刷新时的重复处理。
完善 Spotlight 深色图标支持，并改进浅底、渐变、圆角及备用图标的处理效果。
改善日历日期与星期的可读性，同时保留图标主体颜色和细节。
新增图片壁纸自适应暗化，可根据壁纸亮度动态调整暗化程度。
壁纸暗化支持 iOS 16–18 主屏幕与锁屏，跟随深色模式并支持手动强度调节；默认关闭。
壁纸与图标功能独立控制：深色图标支持 iOS 15–17，iOS 18 使用系统原生图标。
新增 iOS 17–18 图片壁纸暗化，跟随系统深色模式并支持调节强度。
壁纸与图标功能现可独立控制；壁纸暗化默认关闭。
iOS 18 保留系统原生深色图标；iOS 17 及以下继续使用插件图标功能。
新增默认混合模式，结合 Apple 与 Chroma 两种处理方式，改善不同图标的深色效果。
新增 App 自带深色图标优先与白色、浅灰色反转选项，并支持在设置中重启桌面。
优化首次生成后的缓存复用；首次生成或切换设置时可能短暂卡顿。

en.name: DarkIcon
en.tagline: Dark icons and image wallpaper dimming for iOS 15–18.
description: DarkIcon automatically generates dark app icons that follow system appearance across the Home Screen, folders, and Spotlight on iOS 15–17, and dims Home Screen and Lock Screen wallpapers on iOS 16–18.
Adaptive wallpaper dimming responds to image brightness, applying more dimming to bright images and less to dark images. Manual intensity control and Dark Mode tracking remain available.
On iOS 18, native system dark icons are preserved and the tweak's icon feature stays disabled. The original icon modes remain available on iOS 17 and earlier.
The searchable icon preview list compares Light and Dark results and identifies whether an app-provided dark asset or an algorithm was used.
Light Mode skips unnecessary dark icon work, while dark results are reused through disk cache and a bounded memory cache.
en.notice: ⚠️ Version 0.9.4 performs unnecessary icon processing in Light Mode; upgrading to 0.9.5 is strongly recommended. Wallpaper dimming is not guaranteed to work with every system, dynamic, or special wallpaper type. iOS 15 uses the system's wallpaper dimming and does not enable the tweak's wallpaper feature.
features: Adaptive Home Screen and Lock Screen wallpaper dimming on iOS 16–18
Brightness-aware automatic dimming with optional manual intensity control
Independent wallpaper and icon controls, with wallpaper dimming off by default
Home Screen icons that follow system appearance on iOS 15–17
Dark icon support in Spotlight search
Searchable icon preview list with Light/Dark comparison and native-versus-algorithm labels
On-demand background preview and icon generation instead of processing every app at once
Skip unnecessary dark icon processing in Light Mode for better Home Screen startup
Disk cache plus bounded memory cache for dark icons to reduce long-term memory use
Clear Icon Cache in Settings; previews directly reuse disk results
Default hybrid mode with individually selectable Apple and Chroma modes
Preference for app-provided dark icons with improved iOS 17 Dark-asset loading and optional white and light-gray inversion
Improved dark results for light backgrounds, gradients, rounded artwork, and fallback icons
Improved Calendar date and weekday readability while preserving subject colors and details
compatibility: Icon features support iOS 15–17; tweak wallpaper dimming supports iOS 16–18
Uses system wallpaper dimming on iOS 15 and native system dark icons on iOS 18
usage: Open Settings → DarkIcon to configure icon and wallpaper dimming independently; wallpaper dimming is off by default with adaptive or manual intensity options
Search apps in the icon preview list, compare Light and Dark results, and check whether each result uses a native asset or an algorithm
Use Clear Icon Cache in Settings when needed; the Home Screen, folders, Spotlight, and previews rebuild on demand and reuse results

changes: Urgently fixed unnecessary icon processing in Light Mode introduced in 0.9.4, improving Home Screen startup.
Improved memory and caching by removing the long-lived source-image cache and using disk cache plus bounded memory cache for dark icons.
Icon loading and generation now run on demand in the background while preserving native Dark priority; Settings adds Clear Icon Cache and previews reuse disk results.
Added a searchable icon preview list with Light/Dark comparison and native-versus-algorithm labels.
Previews now load on demand and reuse cache; fixed dark icons lingering in Light Mode and improved Home Screen, folder, and Spotlight refreshes.
Improved preference for native Dark assets on iOS 17 and fixed display issues caused by incorrect artwork selection and preview scaling.
Improved dark icon caching by retaining completed results in Light Mode, reducing repeated processing during Home Screen paging, folder access, and icon refreshes.
Improved dark icon support in Spotlight and refined results for light backgrounds, gradients, rounded artwork, and fallback icons.
Improved Calendar date and weekday readability while preserving the icon subject colors and details.
Added adaptive image wallpaper dimming that adjusts dynamically to wallpaper brightness.
Wallpaper dimming now supports the Home Screen and Lock Screen on iOS 16–18, follows Dark Mode, and offers manual intensity control; it is off by default.
Wallpaper and icon features are controlled independently: dark icons support iOS 15–17, while iOS 18 uses the native system icon feature.
Added image wallpaper dimming on iOS 17–18 with Dark Mode tracking and adjustable intensity.
Wallpaper and icon features can now be controlled independently; wallpaper dimming is off by default.
On iOS 18, native system dark icons are preserved and the tweak icon feature stays disabled; the original icon feature remains available on iOS 17 and earlier.
Added a default hybrid mode that combines Apple and Chroma processing for better results across different icons.
Added preference for app-provided dark icons, optional white and light-gray inversion, and a Home Screen restart action in Settings.
Improved cache reuse after initial generation; the first generation or a settings change may cause a brief slowdown.
